crossRefs.note: The elders of Gilead said to Jephthah, “Yahweh will be witness between us. Surely we will do what you say.”
The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill…
Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break…
“Hear, our God; for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land…
The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.
A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Jephthah
people.line: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim. The men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, “You are fugitives of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the middle of Ephraim, and in the middle of Manasseh.”
translations.bsb: Jephthah then gathered all the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim. And the men of Gilead struck them down because the Ephraimites had said, “You Gileadites are fugitives in Ephraim, living in the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh.”
translations.kjv: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.
translations.asv: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim; and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye are fugitives of Ephraim, ye Gileadites, in the midst of Ephraim, and in the midst of Manasseh.
